title: Re-figuring an Unsigned Patient Payment Plan Offer: Account Action Reference
content:
**Rule.** A **Patient Payment Plan** offer the patient has not yet signed (pending signature) is re-figured on the balance it carries when that balance has changed since the offer was made, an add-on enrolled on the offer included; a signed plan is never re-figured under this rule. On an offer not yet signed a reduction is taken into the installment when the offer is re-figured under this rule; on a signed plan a reduction still never changes the installment amount, it shortens the remaining schedule, and the final installment absorbs the remainder.

**What still holds at a plan's creation.** At a plan's creation the down payment is still the tier's down payment percentage of the enrolled total, rounded half-up to the cent; the term is still the number of monthly installments the patient asks for, never more than the tier's maximum term, and the maximum term when the patient states no term; and the installment is still the financed amount (enrolled total less the down payment) divided by the term, rounded half-up to the cent, but never below the tier's minimum monthly payment, and when that floor applies the schedule has as many installments as the floor needs. In every case the final installment absorbs the remainder. The down payment deducted on a re-figure serves only to reach the financed amount; the down payment collected at signing is the one set when the patient signs.

## Booking the re-figured offer

**Capability.** The offer's regular monthly installment is replaced by the amount given and its number of monthly installments by the term given; the enrolled balances, the down payment on the offer, the due dates and the pending signature status are left as they are. The offer then shows the re-figured installment and term.

**How it is invoked.** `refigure_plan_offer_04613189` is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `plan_id` | the reference number of the unsigned payment plan offer, as returned by the payment plan lookup for this patient | plan reference number |
| `monthly_payment_usd` | the re-figured regular monthly installment | USD with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded by the caller; a plain number without a currency sign |
| `term_months` | the number of monthly installments the re-figured offer is booked with | a positive integer |

**Return.** A confirmation of the form "Offer <plan reference> re-figured: <amount> USD per month over <number> months." Receiving it means the re-figured installment and term were booked.
